title: L'age d'Or
identity: Jacques Ibert's L’âge d’or is an alto saxophone and piano excerpt from the ballet Le Chevalier errant, published by Leduc as AL21654. The Philharmonie de Paris guide lists a duration of about 2:30 and describes legato sixteenth-note phrases without detached articulation.

evidence.claim: Philharmonie de Paris’s 10 ans avec le saxophone lists L’Âge d’or for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL21654, 1956, about 2:30, with legato sixteenth-note phrases and no detached articulation.
Institutional catalog record gives Leduc c1956 and identifies the work as an excerpt from Le Chevalier errant.
Ibert catalogue lists Arno Bornkamp and pianist S. Grotenhuis in a recording of the saxophone work.

review_focus: Inference from the Philharmonie guide's specific description: examine connected sixteenth-note phrasing and sustain the legato character across the excerpt.
collection_flag: A ballet excerpt, not originally composed as a standalone saxophone work; a saxophone-and-piano edition and professional recording are documented.

listening.description: Composer catalogue credits Arno Bornkamp with S. Grotenhuis, piano.
listening.verification: Recording credit identified; playback not auditioned.

gaps: Guide text is available, but no score or recording was inspected; exact articulation, range, and edition-specific details remain unknown.
